## Publication Information

**Date:** 1874-1876

**Imprint:** <i>MP</i> (July 1874-June 1876)

**Notes:** This serial story does not seem to have been published separately.  The attribution to Hart does not rest solely on the letter;  it is described as by the author of <i>Mrs Jerningham's Journal</i>.
